hook.text: Your browser has a cached page. Is it still fresh? Instead of downloading again, it asks: has this changed?

buildup.text: Conditional requests use If-None-Match (ETag) or If-Modified-Since headers to check for changes.

discovery.text: If unchanged, the server returns 304 Not Modified — no body, just a confirmation. Bandwidth saved.

twist.text: Generating ETags for dynamic content adds server-side computation. For static files, the web server handles it.

climax.text: Conditional requests save bandwidth and latency by transferring data only when it has actually changed.

punchline.text: Ask if it changed — skip the download if it didn't.

quiz.question: What does a 304 Not Modified response mean?
options: The cached version is still valid; no need to download again
